name: What is the average cost of a bathroom renovation in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of a bathroom renovation in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a bathroom renovation in Orange County can vary widely. A basic refresh, including new paint, fixtures, and possibly a new vanity, might range from $10,000 to $15,000. A mid-range remodel with updated finishes, a new shower, and minor layout changes typically falls between $20,000 and $35,000. High-end renovations featuring custom cabinetry, luxury materials, and significant structural changes can exceed $50,000. The final cost depends on material choices, labor, and the complexity of the design. We provide a detailed estimate after an on-site consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Average bathroom renovation costs in Orange County range from $10,000 for basic updates to over $50,000 for high-end remodels. Costs depend on materials and scope.
